info.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Next Notes listens while you hold the push-to-talk key so it can turn your speech into text.
info.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Next Notes transcribes your speech on-device to insert text where you're typing.
info.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Next Notes records what you hear during a meeting so it can transcribe the other participants on-device. Audio never leaves this Mac.
info.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Next Notes asks Mail to write a draft, send an email or reply, only after you approve it, so it goes out from your own Google account.
info.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Next Notes reads your calendar to know when a meeting starts, so it can offer to take notes.
info.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Next Notes notifies you before a meeting recording starts, when notes are ready, and when a reminder you set with the Agent is due.
info.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Next Notes lists the names of what is on your Desktop so your assistant can find your files. It never reads what is inside them.
info.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Next Notes lists the names of what is in your Documents folder so your assistant can find your files. It never reads what is inside them.
info.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Next Notes lists the names of what is in your Downloads folder so your assistant can find your files. It never reads what is inside them.
